He argued that CEOs, CIOs, and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but are worried that new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches, or cause applications to be hacked or hijacked. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How AI Is Eroding the First Rung of the Tech Job Ladder
title_cn: 人工智能如何侵蚀科技工作阶梯的第一级
summary: The US information sector shed roughly 23,000 jobs in August, offering another potential signal of how AI is reshaping the labor market. Northeastern University Professor Alicia Modestino discusses why tech may be the “canary in the coal mine,” with her research showing a decline in junior versus senior software developer vacancies since ChatGPT’s release. She also discusses why employers are demanding more experience, judgment and human-centric skills from entry-level workers. She joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic’s $15 Billion Credit Line Sets Stage for IPO
title_cn: Anthropic 的 150 亿美元信贷额度为 IPO 奠定了基础

Rainmaker Securities co-founder and Managing Director Greg Martin discusses why Anthropic’s planned $15 billion revolving credit facility strengthens its position ahead of a potential offering. He also shares how its rapid growth could support a valuation above SpaceX’s at IPO and why a successful debut could “open the floodgates” for companies including Oura, neoclouds and other long-awaited tech listings. He joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

He also discusses divisions among House Democrats and the role of the Progressive Caucus if Democrats win control of the chamber. title: Strong Payrolls Fuel Fed Hike Bets | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 9/4/2026
title_cn: 强劲的就业人数推动美联储加息押注|彭博商业周刊日报 9/4/2026
summary: A stronger-than-anticipated increase in US jobs drove stocks and short-dated bonds lower, with traders boosting their bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates this month. While analysts expect the September Fed decision will hinge on next week’s inflation data, swap contracts priced in an over 50% chance of a hike. Anna Wong, Chief US Economist at Bloomberg Economics, and Constance Hunter, Chief Economist and Head of Research at Economist Enterprise, join to discuss. Plus, Bloomberg News White House & Washington Correspondent Jeff Mason discusses President Trump's reaction to the payrolls report and his announcement that he will allow ranchers to process their own beef.  Finally, Poonam Goyal, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Analyst for E-Commerce and Retail, breaks down Lululemon's weaker-than-expected earnings report, with shares of the athleisure company falling close to 19% to their lowest level since May 2018. (Source: Bloomberg)
